title: Score-Based Diffusion Modeling for Nonparametric Empirical Bayes in Heteroscedastic Gaussian Mixtures
one_line: 扩散模型应用于异方差高斯混合贝叶斯估计，理论局限明显

weaknesses: 理论分析在观测噪声水平下存在不可避免的平滑成本
